comparison.objective: Register a windowed plate behind an inspection screen despite grasp-related visual occlusion.
comparison.physical_skill: Visibility-aware grasping, supported regrasp, and precision planar registration.
comparison.success_condition: Released, supported, stable alignment within 3 mm for full credit or 12 mm for partial credit.
comparison.reason: Tests active perception and geometric registration, not mechanical unlocking, rotary damping adjustment, relocking, or impact-cycle evaluation. Body supplies only band-level rubric details, but distinction is clear.
